name: drone_a2_sensors
description: Forward 60 deg radar whose sensitivity is given as a RADAR EQUATION link budget instead of a tuned distance. tx_power_w / antenna_gain_dbi / wavelength_m / min_detectable_signal_w are datasheet quantities; the runtime derives detection_reference_range from them via Rmax = [Pt*G^2*lambda^2*sigma / ((4pi)^3 * Smin)]^(1/4), so it need not be tuned by hand. These values (77 GHz, 10 mW, 25 dBi) yield Rmax = 6.00 m against the 1 m^2 reference target -- deliberately matching the hand-tuned detection_reference_range in drone-a2-sensors-rcs.json, so the two manifests are directly comparable. Note the scale: the same radar with a realistic -110 dBm receiver would reach 166 m; Smin is raised here because the DAA scenarios are a 1/10-scale re-creation. reference_rcs_m2 is also the baseline that a per-target RCS (geom user= via hakoniwa-simenv-data actors.py --rcs) is scaled from, as Rmax ~ sigma^(1/4).
